text:
alex: Kicking off the midnight change window now. Canary batch 1/4 going to us-west-2, pinning service image to r23.7. Runbook linked: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/deploy-unwind
Priya: Thanks — watching metrics. Can you confirm the expected error budget delta for this canary? :eyes:
lee: Preflight checks passed for infra and config. Autoscale policy still at conservative values.
sre-oncall: I'm on pageduty, monitoring latency and queue depth. Signal thresholds set in the runbook. If p50 > 120ms or qdepth > 400, we abort.
deploy-bot: preflight: checks OK. Starting canary 1/4. sha=r23.7 image verified. Logs: https://deploys.redwood/logs/2101112222
alex: Noted. If we see a spike, follow the unwind steps (step 2: drain + unpin + rollback). Priya, you'll coordinate comms?
Priya: Yep — comms ready. I'll draft a short status blurb for #releases.
katie: Quick note — there is a stale NLB rule that could cause 5xx during rollout. If we see >2% 5xx, hit the escape hatch.
lee: Copy. Also adding a temp rate limit to frontend to protect downstream during canary.
sre-oncall: Alert fired on a minor increase at +3m: p95 up 30ms, 5xx at 0.6%. Keeping watch.
deploy-bot: canary 2/4 started. routing weight 25%.
alex: If we need to unwind, use this command in ops console: ```rollback service api --to r23.6 --force-unpin --coordinated-drain 60s``` Do not run unless SRE confirms.
Priya: Got it. If unwind, I'll post: "Abort canary — initiating unwind. Rolling back to r23.6. ETA ~7min."
sre-oncall: p95 now +80ms and 5xx rose to 2.8% in the canary cohort. Recommend pause and investigate.
alex: Pausing rollout. Deploy-bot, freeze further canaries.
deploy-bot: deploy freeze applied by alex. Remaining canaries halted.
lee: Checking logs, seeing a mismatch in kv cache keys after the image change. Posting snippets in ops thread.
katie: Agree with unwind. This matches the failure mode in runbook appendix B.
Priya: Prepping the unwind message now.
sre-oncall: I'm executing coordinated drain on canary nodes, draining sessions. ETA ~90s.
alex: After drain complete, proceed with unpin and roll back. Confirm before unpin.
sre-oncall: Drain complete. 0 active sessions. Proceed with rollback.
lee: Rolling back service to r23.6 via canary controller.
deploy-bot: rollback initiated: target=r23.6, initiated_by=lee. Progress: 30% -> 100%
Priya: Posted update to #releases and #status: "Canary aborted, rolling back to r23.6; root cause cache key incompatibility; detailed followup in postmortem." :white_check_mark:
alex: Good job everyone. Leaving the freeze in place until we validate a fix and run a controlled patch deploy. Next steps: pair on a small repro, patch the kv migration, then staged deploy.
sre-oncall: I'll keep alerts muted for the release channel and reopen once metrics are stable.
Priya: Filing an immediate ticket and adding owners.
lee: Will run an isolated migration test in a sandbox and share results in the runbook thread.
alex: Closing this thread. Thanks for quick unwind.
